terminals.name: api
terminals.command: set -a; . ./.env; set +a; export DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL:-postgres://paymentgate:paymentgate@localhost:5432/paymentgate}"; exec node apps/api/src/server.mjs

terminals.name: watcher
terminals.command: set -a; . ./.env; set +a; export DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL:-postgres://paymentgate:paymentgate@localhost:5432/paymentgate}"; exec node apps/watcher/src/main.mjs --loop

terminals.name: web
terminals.command: set -a; . ./.env; set +a; exec npx pnpm@9.15.0 --filter @paymentgate/web dev --host 0.0.0.0
